title: Signature Global-led consortium buys 194 acre land via auction for Rs 194 cr - The Economic Times
text:
A consortium led by Signature Global has successfully acquired 474.66 acres of land in Raigad, Maharashtra. The bid was valued at Rs 194 crore and enables the company to expand beyond Delhi-NCR. Signature Global will hold a 65 percent stake in the special purpose vehicle for this land. The management sees significant potential in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region property market.
